name: router_plugin_pipeline
invariants: Only a Policy Decision v1 allow outcome may enter routing.
Request, registry, and candidate configuration use the same tenant_id and config_version.
A route_strategy resolves to an ordered plugin pipeline through the registry; core lifecycle code does not dispatch strategy-specific branches.
Adding a registered plugin changes registry composition, not the core request lifecycle.
Every plugin and final route decision emits a structured reason_code and trace metadata.
Candidates and decisions contain opaque Provider identifiers only, never endpoint or credential material.
The online Data Plane routing path never queries Control Plane PostgreSQL.
Usage, Billing, Audit, and Analytics persistence never blocks routing.
